source.note: Search summary (results: Wikipedia, OnTheSnow, PeakVisor, vail.com, Epic Pass pages): 5,317 skiable acres (seven Back Bowls); trails 195 (18% beginner / 29% intermediate / 53% advanced); lift system "31 total" listed as 2 gondolas (12- and 10-person), 4 high-speed six-seat, 14 high-speed quad, 1 fixed-grip quad and 2 fixed-grip triple chairs, and 9 surface lifts — which adds up to 32, not 31. Another result in the same summary said 277 trails and 33 lifts. Season of the figures not stated.

character: A very large resort above the town of Vail on I-70 and the flagship of Vail Resorts, with long groomed front-side runs, the open Back Bowls and the separate Blue Sky Basin. Base areas are Vail Village, Lionshead and Golden Peak; it is busy and expensive at peak times.
learning: Reference note: learning terrain has been concentrated at Golden Peak and at Eagle's Nest (top of the Eagle Bahn Gondola), with lessons through the Vail Ski & Snowboard School. Confirm where first-timers start in 2026-27 and the lesson products.

announcedOpening.text: Planned opening Nov. 13, 2026 (subject to weather and conditions)

source.note: Vail Resorts 2026-27 opening-dates release (reported by Unofficial Networks on 18 Aug 2026; also Denver7, Summit Daily, SnowBrains): opening dates are subject to change based on weather and conditions.

season.notes: 2026-27: planned opening Nov. 13, 2026 (Vail Resorts release). Closing not announced; OnTheSnow "projected closing" listing (https://www.onthesnow.com/united-states/projected-closing), a projection, not an announcement — Apr. 11, 2027 projected. Confirm.

prices.note: 2026-27 peak adult ticket $374 (Beaver Creek $392 is the only higher one in the roundup). An undated OnTheSnow listing shows $307 weekday / $335 weekend. Vail Resorts sells cheaper tickets 4+ weeks ahead (policy announced Dec 2025); advance prices were not captured.

source.note: Search summary of 2026-27 price roundups (TownLift, SnowBrains, Unofficial Networks, Sep 2026).

airports.basis: Estimate from typical routing (I-70 E from Gypsum to the Vail exits); not a routing-service result. Winter service at EGE is limited and seasonal (Piste reference, confirm).

Estimate from typical routing (Peña Blvd to I-70 W through the Eisenhower Tunnel and over Vail Pass); not a routing-service result. Winter weekend traffic and closures on I-70 (Eisenhower Tunnel, Vail Pass) can add hours.

transfers.name: Epic Mountain Express (shared airport shuttle)
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: Vail Resorts' shared-ride shuttle (formerly branded Colorado Mountain Express) has run from DEN and EGE to Vail and Summit County. 2026-27 schedules and fares are unconfirmed.

transfers.name: Bustang (CDOT intercity bus, I-70 West line)
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: CDOT's intercity coach has run along I-70 from Denver with stops including Frisco and Vail. Confirm 2026-27 stops, schedule and fares.

transfers.name: Town of Vail buses
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: free in-town buses link Vail Village, Lionshead and Golden Peak with town lots and neighbourhoods.

transfers.name: Rental car
transfers.notes: Reference, confirm: winter driving on I-70 and Vail Pass; Colorado's traction law can apply on I-70 in winter. Check COtrip.

research.confidenceNotes: Upgraded on 2026-09-30 from reference-only using batched web searches (search-result summaries; page fetching is blocked, so no official page was read directly). Search-summary facts: planned 2026-27 opening, terrain stats, the 2026-27 peak ticket price, a projected closing (notes only) and the tickets link. Still Piste reference data (unverified): identity, coordinates and weather points, operator, elevations, features, airport drive estimates and transfers. Summaries sometimes blend several result pages, so the source URL on each fact group is the most specific result that carried it — confirm at source before relying on it. Snow-report, lift-status and trail-map links follow the URL pattern shared by all Vail Resorts sites (terrain-and-lift-status.aspx and mountain-info.aspx were seen in results for sister resorts); they were not individually opened.
